text.title: Express slot reminder
text.role: a Moscow parent who orders groceries every week
text.goal: get a reminder 15 minutes before my delivery slot
text.benefit: I do not miss the slot and the courier does not wait: 0 missed slots a month
text.notes: reminder time fixed at 15 minutes; no SMS in this version; slot change is out of scope
text.then3: no push; the slot shows as cancelled
text.then4: push appears on the lock screen within 60 seconds
